selected.reason: Only candidate with five clean rows: four snug receptacle clamps from different tilts plus a stem pinch leaving the head free; large, complete, recognisable sunflower.
Next best score; two snug receptacle pinches from different directions plus three light petal-base clamps give diverse in-hand poses; different mesh from ysogni.

warnings: vkgdsl and zdmbjt share bbox 223x90x77 and look identical (same mesh, different grasp sets); pibfxd and mdpoct likewise (191x81x62).
All grasps in this group are graspgen mode C with one finger at 0 mm; R=1 applied uniformly for that.
Most candidates only hold the flower through petals; apart from ysogni and zdmbjt no model offers 3 clean receptacle/stem grasps.
